answers.query: What does PAY-504 mean and what should we check first?

response.query: What does PAY-504 mean and what should we check first?
response.answer:
PAY-504 means Payments API timed out waiting for a Ledger Database connection.

First, check the payments_db_pool_wait_seconds histogram and payments_db_pool_active gauge.

Next, correlate the checkout request ID with payment traces.

chunk.title: Payments API - Connection Pool Runbook
chunk.text: PAY-504 means Payments API timed out waiting for a Ledger Database connection. Check the payments_db_pool_wait_seconds histogram and payments_db_pool_active gauge. Correlate the checkout request ID with payment traces. A healthy HTTP endpoint does not rule out database pool exhaustion.

chunk.title: 05-legacy-alerts
chunk.text:
code: PAY-504; service: Payments API; symptom: Database connection acquisition timeout; first_check: Check pool wait and active connections

code: INV-409; service: Inventory API; symptom: Stock reservation conflict; first_check: Check reservation expiry

code: AUTH-401; service: Identity Service; symptom: Expired access token; first_check: Check token expiry and issuer

chunk.title: Inventory API - Stock Reservation Runbook
chunk.text: INV-409 indicates a stock reservation conflict. Confirm available stock in Stock Database and inspect reservation expiry. INV-409 is not PAY-504 and does not indicate Ledger Database pool exhaustion.

chunk.title: Payments API - Connection Pool Runbook
chunk.text: For PAY-504, compare active connections to the configured pool limit of 40 per pod. Inspect database slow queries and the most recent deployment. Contact Payments Team for the API and Platform Team for Ledger Database. Collect evidence before suggesting a rollback; the assistant never executes changes.

chunk.title: 07-operations-reference
chunk.text:
Use these thresholds after an operator-approved recovery. This assistant does not execute infrastructure changes. Confirm the current incident with traces before applying a historical incident resolution.

| Metric                     | Recovery target   | Observation window   |
|----------------------------|-------------------|----------------------|
| Payment timeout rate       | Below 1%          | 10 minutes           |
| Connection acquisition p95 | Below 200 ms      | 10 minutes           |
| Checkout success rate      | Above 99%         | 10 minutes           |

chunk.title: Northstar Commerce - Service Catalog
chunk.text:
Ledger Database is owned by Platform Team.
Ledger Database stores payment authorization records. Database connection limits and slow queries should be checked during payment incidents.

chunk.title: Northstar Commerce - Service Catalog
chunk.text:
Checkout Service depends on Payments API.
Checkout Service depends on Inventory API.
Checkout Service is owned by Commerce Team.
Checkout Service handles purchase confirmation. Correlation IDs connect checkout requests to downstream payment traces. Checkout does not store card numbers.

chunk.title: Payments API - Connection Pool Runbook
chunk.text: After an operator-approved recovery, verify that payment timeout rate is below 1%, connection acquisition p95 is below 200 ms, and checkout success rate is above 99% for ten minutes. Do not recommend raising connection limits without checking the total database capacity.

chunk.title: INC-204 - Checkout Timeout Postmortem
chunk.text: An operator rolled Payments API back to release 2.8.0. Payments Team added a connection-release regression test; Platform Team added pool-wait alerting. The incident was closed after checkout success remained above 99% for ten minutes.

chunk.title: Identity Service - Access Runbook
chunk.text: AUTH-401 means an access token is expired or has an invalid issuer. Check token expiry, clock skew, audience and issuer. Never paste raw tokens into incident tickets.

chunk.title: INC-204 - Checkout Timeout Postmortem
chunk.text: Incident INC-204 was caused by a database connection leak in Payments API release 2.8.1. A missing connection release in the authorization retry path exhausted the 40-connection pool. This historical cause is not proof that a new incident has the same cause.

chunk.title: Inventory API - Stock Reservation Runbook
chunk.text: Supply Team owns Inventory API and Stock Database. Investigate reservation conflicts with Supply Team. Do not contact Payments Team for a confirmed stock-only conflict.

chunk.title: Northstar Commerce - Service Catalog
chunk.text:
Payments API depends on Ledger Database.
Payments API is owned by Payments Team.
Payments API uses a pooled database connection for authorization records. Connection acquisition waits can produce upstream timeout errors even when the database is reachable.

chunk.title: 07-operations-reference
chunk.text: The configured Payments API connection pool limit is 40 per pod. Increasing it requires an operator capacity review of Ledger Database.
